decision_gate.four_core_recovery: PASS_FOR_DEFENSIVE_COUNTERSTROKE; 250-278 ready, 150-184 synchronized one-cycle package centered.
decision_gate.Taiho: PARTIAL; C+/B-, 40-52 ready and limited independent combat, but not fifth synchronized strike deck.
decision_gate.US_deck_window: CLOSED; 7 CV + 5 CVL immediate pool by 20 Mar centered after Lexington/Hornet return.
decision_gate.surface_strength: PASS; Japanese BB/CA/DD depth remains strong, but not enough to negate US air/radar/AA system in open water.
decision_gate.information: No fixed US amphibious target yet; searching east for TF58 remains negative-EV.

main_decision: CONTINUE_REGENERATION_AND_FORWARD_REACTION_POSTURE; DO_NOT_CHASE_TF58. Prepare to counter a fixed US raid/amphibious geometry in the western Carolines/Palau/Marianas system.

orders_20Mar.four_core: Keep Shokaku/Zuikaku/Hiryu/Soryu concentrated as one combat-training system on the Davao-Celebes Sea/Tarakan support axis, rotating anchorages and sea-training areas rather than fixing the whole force in one harbor.
orders_20Mar.Taiho: Finish home-area work-up; prepare southward release after 21-25 Mar gate. Do not rush into an eastward combat sortie merely to exploit a US weakness that has now closed.
orders_20Mar.secondary_carriers: Continue qualification/ferry/replacement-absorption role. Preserve a separate limited combat reserve but do not drain instructors to make every hull nominally full.
orders_20Mar.Palau: Treat as forward ISR/air/repair node and tripwire, not a safe Combined-Fleet mass anchorage after the Truk lesson. Begin reducing nonessential high-value ship/tanker loiter time and maintain rapid-dispersal plans without pretending knowledge of a 30-Mar raid.
orders_20Mar.land_air_submarines: Use K706/other land-based air, submarines, flying boats/seaplanes and pickets to detect TF58 movement. Their job is to create the fresh track that releases the fleet, not to win the campaign alone.
orders_20Mar.surface_reserve: Keep heavy units on southern fuel axis for a fixed landing/fire-support target or a damaged/detached US group; no independent commerce raid and no blind eastward sweep.

release_gate: US mission geometry fixed by raid/landing/support requirement
four-core strike cohesion maintained after transit
Taiho integration credit counted separately unless its synchronization gate has passed
expected gain includes high-value US carrier/transport/fire-support mission kills
strategic_read: Japan has used the early-March breathing space productively: the four-core is substantially healthier and Taiho is becoming useful. But the US reinforcement curve has caught up faster than Japan can create a fully integrated fifth deck, so the rational next move remains ambush/counterstroke rather than initiative-seeking fleet battle.
